notes: "ncert" = the same NCERT chapters StudyVerse already has for CBSE (content/curriculum.json). Only marked where a cited source confirms the board uses those NCERT books for that class and subject in 2026-27.

Class 9: CBSE moved to brand-new NCERT books in 2026-27. Most state boards (confirmed: UP, MP, Goa) still use the previous Class 9 NCERT books, so Class 9 is never mapped unless the new books are confirmed.

Classes 10-12: NCERT has not changed these books for 2026-27, so a state board that prescribes NCERT books uses the same chapters. State boards may delete different chapters than CBSE; StudyVerse follows the CBSE 2026-27 deletions.
Economics (11-12) is not mapped for state boards: UP pairs the four NCERT economics books differently from CBSE, and other boards are unconfirmed.
Hindi-medium boards use Hindi translations of the same NCERT books; StudyVerse content is in English (Hindi language subjects excepted).
Schools in Delhi, Chandigarh and other places affiliated to CBSE, KVs and JNVs should pick CBSE.
Confidence: high = official/authorised 2026-27 book list; medium = government decision or reliable news/secondary source without a 2026-27 subject list.
